Kasper Gymoese Berthelsen is a lead consultant (*ledende overlæge*) and a key figure in the governance of acute surgical quality in Denmark. He serves as a member of the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Committee) for the Acute Surgery Database, where he helps guide organizational oversight and quality improvement initiatives [^src1]. 

Within the committee, Berthelsen acts as the official representative for two major institutions: the Danish Society of Anesthesiology and Intensive Medicine (*Dansk Selskab for Anæstesiologi og Intensiv Medicin*) and Aalborg University Hospital (*Aalborg Universitetshospital*) in the North Denmark Region (*Region Nordjylland*) [^src1]. Through these roles, he is responsible for managing and ensuring anesthesiological quality across acute surgical pathways [^src1]. His work intersects with broader national efforts to overcome systemic barriers in healthcare quality measurement, such as improving the early identification of acute high-risk patients and standardizing clinical indicators across regional and tertiary hospitals [^src1].
